findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_tiktok_script_and_hook_inputs, get_tiktok_niche_trends, get_tiktok_posting_times, get_tiktok_trending_hashtags, check_tiktok_account, get_tiktok_growth_plan · Private data: get_tiktok_script_and_hook_inputs, check_tiktok_account · Public sink: get_tiktok_niche_trends, get_tiktok_posting_times, get_tiktok_trending_hashtags · Destructive: check_tiktok_view_drop.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_tiktok_script_and_hook_inputs, get_tiktok_niche_trends, get_tiktok_posting_times, get_tiktok_trending_hashtags, check_tiktok_account, get_tiktok_growth_plan · Private data: get_tiktok_script_and_hook_inputs, check_tiktok_account · Public sink: get_tiktok_niche_trends, get_tiktok_posting_times, get_tiktok_trending_hashtags · Destructive: check_tiktok_view_drop

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
